info.name: ✨ NewJeans-Inspired Chrome Wallpaper ✨
info.description:
Step into the dreamy, Y2K-inspired world of NewJeans with this custom Chrome wallpaper! Featuring a soft pastel gradient of blues and pinks, this theme captures the fresh and youthful energy of the group. A subtle starry overlay adds a nostalgic touch, while the sleek, modern typography reflects their effortlessly cool aesthetic.

With a minimal yet stylish design, this wallpaper brings a perfect blend of retro and futuristic vibes, just like NewJeans themselves. Whether you're a Bunnies fan or just love aesthetic themes, this design keeps your Chrome experience looking fresh, fun, and fashionable. ???
